'''February 2000 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Broken Games, Lake City, Washington on 5 February 2000. [[Charles Hickey]] won it. It is known from Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-07-lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00d231/ lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 7 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-07-lake-city-washinton-feb-5th-00d231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Lake City, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Charles Hickey]]
